name: BACH_0370
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (78%)** · Confident · Careful review

Conformal set and MUSK agree on Benign, but neighbors lean InSitu and tumor-cell metrics are high.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Benign 78%, InSitu 21%, Invasive 1% | Clear lead; InSitu second |
| Conformal set | {Benign} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 1.00 / 100th percentile | No flag; OOD rank maximal |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Agrees |
| Similar cases | 1 of 5 Benign; 4 InSitu | Neighbors disagree |

## Tissue evidence
- **Scarce benign stroma/fat** (region 1) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical score nudges concept model toward invasive [F4] · Validated
- **Atypical cells confined in ducts** (regions 3, 7, 10) · ↓ invasive · Above typical; associated with lower invasive likelihood [F2] · Weak
- **Tumor nuclei 84% of sampled, 99th percentile** (regions 2, 4, 6) · context · Dense neoplastic nuclei on three sampled regions [F7] · Measured
- **Frequent mitoses** (regions 2, 5, 6) · ↑ invasive · Scored high; concept model associates with invasive · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Deletion test excludes 0 (drop 0.54, CI 0.47-0.60); faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI (-0.005 to 0.007) includes 0: not shown to reflect the classifier. Unreliable here: normal lobules, mitoses, necrosis.

## Could be wrong if
- Four of five similar cases are InSitu; InSitu holds 21% probability.
- Tumor-nuclei metrics (99th percentile) come from only 3 of 12 regions and conflict with the Benign call.

## Check on the slide
1. **4, 5, 6** — Per-region invasive risk 98%, 76%, 45%; look for stromal invasion versus in-situ nests.
2. **3, 7, 10** — Confirm atypical cells stay confined to ducts; spot check was 12/20.
3. **2, 4, 6** — Verify nuclei labeled neoplastic; mean nuclear size is lowest in the reference set.
